Lookup Data¶

This section describes the key fields that reference data from the lookup tables.

LookupLaterality¶

Laterality defines the side of the body where the lesion is located.

This is referenced by the following froms:

Form where this is used

Field where this is used

Diagnosis

cancer_side

Lesion

lesion_laterality

Pathology

tumor_side

RadiationTherapy

radiotherapy_side

Surgery

surgery_side

Note

The API endpoint for this lookup to show the list of all lateralities is: https://backend.chavi.ai/api/v1/lookup/laterality/ The API endpoint to get the details of a specific laterality is: https://backend.chavi.ai/api/v1/lookup/laterality/{code}/
